campaigns.name: Dabbah-NewWebsite
campaigns.description: Re-engagement series for lapsed/cold customers who ordered before. 8-step email nurture over ~47 days. Tells the story of what changed at DabbahWala.

campaigns.name: Dabbah-NewCustomer-Onboarding
campaigns.description: Welcome series for first-time customers. Builds trust, explains how DabbahWala works, and pitches subscriptions.

subject_ideas: Your first meal is on its way
sequence.body_theme: Warm welcome. Thank them for the first order. Set expectations: fresh food, cooked to order, same-day delivery. Mention rotating menu.
sequence.cta: Browse this week's menu at dabbahwala.com

sequence.body_theme: Explain the process: Order -> Cooked fresh -> Delivered same day. Lighter oils, no MSG, small batches. Not restaurant food, everyday food.

subject_ideas: Save time with a weekly plan
sequence.body_theme: Introduce subscription option. Save 15-20%, no daily decision-making, priority delivery. Flexible: pause/cancel anytime. Focus on convenience.
Social proof. Share 2-3 real customer testimonials about freshness, taste, convenience. Mention neighborhoods served (Atlanta metro).

subject_ideas: We'd love to cook for you again
sequence.body_theme: Gentle nudge. If they haven't reordered, acknowledge it. No pressure. Mention free delivery over $35. Offer to help via reply.

campaigns.name: Dabbah-ActiveCustomer-Engagement
campaigns.description: Keep active customers engaged with new dishes, seasonal specials, and referral asks. Light touch, value-focused.

subject_ideas: New on the menu this week
sequence.body_theme: Highlight 2-3 new or seasonal dishes. Include appetizing descriptions. Mention they can customize or add sides.

subject_ideas: How to get the most from DabbahWala
sequence.body_theme: If not on subscription, gently pitch it. If already subscribed, offer pairing tips (add sides, desserts). Mention free delivery threshold.
Referral ask. You've ordered X times, you clearly enjoy our food. Share with friends/family. No formal program needed, just genuine word-of-mouth.

subject_ideas: Thank you for being a regular
You're part of the DabbahWala family
sequence.body_theme: Genuine thank you. Acknowledge their loyalty. Mention they can always text for anything. Build personal relationship.

campaigns.name: Dabbah-Lapsed-Winback
campaigns.description: Win back lapsed customers (30-60 days inactive). More urgent tone, highlight improvements, direct CTA.

sequence.body_theme: Acknowledge the gap. Be honest: we know we didn't earn a regular spot. Share 2-3 specific improvements made since they left.
Detail specific changes: cook-to-order, rotating menu, lighter ingredients, easier ordering. Be specific, not vague.
sequence.cta: See the new menu at dabbahwala.com

subject_ideas: Your next order gets special attention
sequence.body_theme: Offer special attention: priority handling, possible surprise from kitchen. Make them feel valued, not just another win-back target.
sequence.cta: Reply MENU or order at dabbahwala.com

sequence.body_theme: Final gentle note. No pressure. Door is always open. Reply MENU anytime. Respect their decision.

campaigns.name: Dabbah-Reactivation
campaigns.description: Last-resort reactivation for 60+ day inactive customers. Direct, honest, outcome-focused.

subject_ideas: We'd like to earn your trust back
sequence.body_theme: Very honest, humble. We didn't deliver on what you expected. Here's what we've done about it. Specific changes, not corporate speak.
Ask for feedback. What didn't work? What would they want different? Show you genuinely care about their experience.
Graceful exit. Thank them for being a customer. Door is always open. No more emails unless they engage. Respect their space.

campaigns.name: Dabbah-AppToDirect
campaigns.description: Convert food delivery app (DoorDash/UberEats/Grubhub) customers to order directly from DabbahWala website.

sequence.body_theme: Thank them for discovering DabbahWala (even via an app). Introduce who we are. Mention we cook fresh, same-day delivery, home-style food.

subject_ideas: A tip that saves you money
sequence.body_theme: Explain benefits of ordering direct: no app fees (saves 15-30%), free delivery over $35, faster handling, ability to customize, subscribe, or just text MENU.

subject_ideas: A better way to order DabbahWala
sequence.body_theme: Specific perks: personalized orders, dietary preferences remembered, priority delivery, occasional kitchen surprises, subscription option for daily convenience.

subject_ideas: Just in case you missed this
sequence.body_theme: Gentle final push. Mention again: same food, lower cost, better service. If they reply MENU, we handle everything personally. No app needed.

creation_priority: Dabbah-AppToDirect (convert app customers to direct — higher margins)
